identityReplayBehaviorChanges: DslClasspathArtifact reads metadata from defining class origin archive bytes, not an independently delegated classpath metadata lookup.
NormeinStandardLibraries replaces source/application-code stdlib artifacts with actual classpath artifact identity and changed provider execution/documentation hashes; adds replayArtifact accessor.
DslReplayVerifier validates resolved actual environment/scope contract, version and fingerprints in addition to supplied identities.

Compile/run real public consumers and Normein/Mantra contract tests, conformance and application acceptance on that public artifact.
Record runtime GAV/complete JAR SHA and library/provider content identity; do not replace historical ae9/lock/performance evidence.
If commit provenance is required, obtain publisher revision mapping/receipt; content-ac5849... alone is not a Git commit.
